checks.check: Current scores cannot distinguish model changes because splits, metrics, or experiments are unreliable.
checks.how: Inspect split overlap, scoring code, version diffs, and repeated-run score variation.

checks.check: Predictions fail basic validity or do not match the trained pipeline.
checks.how: Inspect loading diagnostics, input/output IDs, prediction ranges, and train/inference configurations.

checks.check: Correct runs are blocked by memory, session limits, or repeated expensive work.
checks.how: Use runtime logs and memory profiles to locate the limiting stage.

checks.check: Available task-relevant information is absent, distorted, or diluted in current inputs.
checks.how: Compare raw data with feature tensors and existing feature or modality ablations.

checks.check: Label quality, data coverage, censoring, or sample weighting limits the training signal.
checks.how: Inspect label distributions, event indicators, data provenance, and quality-stratified errors.

checks.check: Learning curves or controlled single-model experiments implicate capacity, objective, or optimization.
checks.how: Inspect train/validation curves and model-family or head comparisons.

checks.check: Correct aligned predictions from multiple sources show potentially complementary errors.
checks.how: Inspect OOF provenance, standalone scores, residual correlations, and current blend ablations.

checks.check: Valid base predictions retain an observable calibration, granularity, or inference-view mismatch.
checks.how: Inspect held-out calibration, target support, domain symmetries, and current post-processing ablations.

checks.check: Related rows cross folds or fold target distributions are visibly skewed.
checks.how: Inspect split IDs and per-fold target summaries.

checks.check: The reported evaluation callback is incorrect, unstable, or a measured runtime bottleneck.
checks.how: Compare metric code, curves, and profiler output with the task’s scoring definition.

checks.check: Multiple edits or stochastic reruns make the latest score movement ambiguous.
checks.how: Review version diffs and repeated baseline scores.

checks.check: Several candidate configurations can be scored on an existing representative holdout.
checks.how: Inspect stored validation predictions, labels, and split provenance; verify candidates used the same rows.

checks.check: Fold target distributions differ substantially despite independent observations.
checks.how: Tabulate class proportions or target-bin histograms by fold and compare with the full labeled sample.

checks.check: Several rows or overlapping windows belong to the same prediction entity.
checks.how: Count repeated entity IDs and intersect IDs or window intervals across the current train and validation partitions.

checks.check: A proposed stacker lacks held-out predictions aligned to common row and fold identifiers.
checks.how: Join each base model’s prediction file to saved fold indices and check that no row was predicted by a model trained on it.

checks.check: Local and public scores have ranked existing checkpoints differently.
checks.how: Compare the paired local/external score table and public sample size; distinguish ranking reversals from repeated-run variation.

checks.check: The current stopping metric differs from the scored objective and selects worse checkpoints in prior comparisons.
checks.how: Compare the configured evaluation callback with the task formula and recorded task scores along training.

checks.check: The task metric fluctuates sharply between nearby iterations while a smooth proxy tracks generalization better.
checks.how: Inspect validation curves and prior stopping-point comparisons on identical folds.

checks.check: Callback values or shapes disagree with an independent calculation.
checks.how: Evaluate a small labeled prediction vector through both code paths and inspect the framework callback arguments.

checks.check: Metric computation dominates repeated training or blending evaluations.
checks.how: Read profiler timings for the callback and compare its output against the existing reference implementation.

checks.check: No complete pipeline has yet produced a scored prediction file.
checks.how: Inspect run artifacts and the experiment log for a successful end-to-end scored baseline.

checks.check: The last score change followed several simultaneous functional edits.
checks.how: Diff the last two scored versions and list changed inputs, checkpoints, training settings, and blend formulas.

checks.check: Existing unchanged runs vary by as much as the candidate gain.
checks.how: Compare repeated scores and prediction files for an identical configuration, including pinned artifacts.

checks.check: A reproducible parameter trend exists but the optimum has not been bracketed.
checks.how: Inspect the trial table for consistently improving values and whether values on both sides have been evaluated.

checks.check: The latest configuration is substantially worse than a reproducible saved baseline.
checks.how: Compare the regression with measured run variation and locate the exact saved configuration and artifacts.

checks.check: Several recent settings failed to improve beyond the measured noise floor.
checks.how: Read the recent sweep table, including failed probes, and compare its range with unchanged-run variation.

checks.check: The first baseline is far below existing scored alternatives and several compatible missing components are already evidenced.
checks.how: Compare available baseline scores and code paths for missing domain preprocessing, suitable models, or averaging; record the loss of attribution before bundling.

checks.check: Failures begin at import, checkpoint resolution, or state loading.
checks.how: Read the earliest error and loading diagnostics.

checks.check: The model runs but rows, features, or executed branches do not match the intended pipeline.
checks.how: Inspect IDs, stage shapes, and per-model prediction counts.

checks.check: Prediction scale, direction, finiteness, or blending arithmetic is invalid.
checks.how: Inspect numeric summaries and manually recompute representative outputs.

checks.check: No usable final output exists or accumulated patches obstruct basic execution.
checks.how: Inspect the first failure and final artifact schema.

checks.check: A configured artifact is missing or its resolved path differs from the saved artifact.
checks.how: List available files and compare full resolved paths, including filename punctuation and cleanup commands.

checks.check: Imports fail or resolve to a different library copy than the checkpoint requires.
checks.how: Inspect import exceptions, module file locations, local package versions, and path ordering.

checks.check: Checkpoint keys, tensor shapes, tokenizer vocabulary, or head dimensions disagree with the constructed model.
checks.how: Compare the saved configuration and state dictionary with the instantiated model under strict loading.

checks.check: Loading appears successful but predictions resemble an untrained or constant model.
checks.how: Inspect loaded parameter statistics, missing-key reports, evaluation mode, and predictions on a small known labeled sample.

checks.check: Outputs are constant across substantial edits or some configured members never produce predictions.
checks.how: Trace loop entry counts, array accumulation, input row IDs, and the exact variable written to disk.

checks.check: A new feature branch receives implausible shapes or values.
checks.how: Print small tensor slices, axis meanings, and statistics before and after each new transform.

checks.check: Inference transforms or fitted preprocessing objects differ from those used for the checkpoint.
checks.how: Compare saved training configuration, feature order, scaler/encoder artifacts, and inference call order.

checks.check: Test categories include unseen levels or the inference code fits a new encoder.
checks.how: Compare category sets and inspect calls to fit, fit_transform, and transform.

checks.check: A preprocessing or target-building step consumes identifiers or labels unavailable at prediction time.
checks.how: Trace input dependencies against the test schema and audit fitting boundaries inside each fold.

checks.check: A supposedly behavior-preserving refactor has changed predictions or has not been checked for equivalence.
checks.how: Locate reference predictions and compare both implementations on the same ordered sample.

checks.check: Prediction units or monotonic direction disagree with the labels or other members.
checks.how: Check target scaling and inverse-link code, and compare standalone held-out score direction with a trusted member.

checks.check: Ensemble scale changes after member removal or the formula uses list arithmetic or an incorrect denominator.
checks.how: Recompute a few rows by hand and compare active member counts, weights, types, and array shapes.

checks.check: Inputs or intermediate network outputs contain non-finite values.
checks.how: Run finite-value checks stage by stage on a small failing batch.

checks.check: The called method or argument belongs to a different API wrapper than the instantiated object.
checks.how: Inspect object types and local function signatures at the failing call.

checks.check: The pipeline fails before completing even one sample or model.
checks.how: Read the first traceback and try the same path on one batch with minimal training.

checks.check: Inference finishes but the expected prediction file is absent or malformed.
checks.how: Read the final artifact and compare its path, row IDs, columns, and numeric values with the required template.

checks.check: Some ensemble output files are missing or fallback arrays are placeholders.
checks.how: Inspect each member file, its provenance and row alignment, and logs identifying which fallback path executed.

checks.check: Repeated patches leave duplicated transformations or hidden dependencies that prevent reliable fixes.
checks.how: Trace the current stages and compare duplicate code paths and their outputs.

checks.check: Runs fail or slow sharply at a reproducible memory peak.
checks.how: Inspect memory profiles and failure traces.

checks.check: Repeated loading, extraction, or full training dominates otherwise working experiments.
checks.how: Compare stage timings across recent runs.

checks.check: Device support or API limitations block a required operation.
checks.how: Inspect runtime exceptions and available local interfaces.

checks.check: The raw table or engineered feature table exceeds memory before model inference starts.
checks.how: Compare dataframe sizes and profiler memory peaks during loading and aggregation.

checks.check: Memory grows between sequential model runs because completed objects remain live.
checks.how: Inspect memory after each model and references to model objects and intermediate arrays.

checks.check: Memory failure occurs in a single forward pass and grows with batch size.
checks.how: Inspect the traceback and peak accelerator memory for progressively smaller batches.

checks.check: Model tensors dominate memory and the current pipeline uses full precision.
checks.how: Inspect tensor dtypes and allocations and any prior paired precision results.

checks.check: A full training run is currently needed just to test code wiring or screen a parameter.
checks.how: Measure run time and inspect whether fold, seed, and iteration counts can be reduced coherently.

checks.check: The expensive upstream outputs are unchanged across downstream experiments.
checks.how: Compare artifact hashes and configurations for repeated feature extraction or base-model inference.

checks.check: A session cannot finish all folds but completed fold checkpoints can be reused.
checks.how: Compare per-fold run time with the session limit and inspect persisted fold manifests.

checks.check: Repeated ranking or subgroup post-processing dominates the inference-adjustment search.
checks.how: Inspect stage timings and compare current rank outputs on tied and grouped predictions with a small exact reference.

checks.check: Variant changes require repeated manual edits that have caused configuration drift.
checks.how: Inspect duplicate constants, path lists, and flags across the notebook.

checks.check: The configured accelerator or dataframe backend does not support a required operation.
checks.how: Inspect the device error, available hardware, and a minimal local backend probe.

checks.check: The current wrapper cannot expose the needed custom metric or iteration control.
checks.how: Inspect the installed wrapper signature and the native training interface used by existing code.

checks.check: The estimator wrapper already supports the required stopping and probability outputs.
checks.how: Inspect its local interface and compare it with the extra dataset and prediction-conversion code currently maintained.

checks.check: Repeated rows are collapsed into a limited summary or their structure is still unknown.
checks.how: Inspect entity histories and the current tabular feature specification.

checks.check: Many engineered inputs are redundant, sparse, or implicated in prior regressions.
checks.how: Review importance stability, missingness, and feature-group ablation results.

checks.check: Missingness or stored numerical precision conflicts with estimator assumptions.
checks.how: Inspect actual dtypes, NaNs, and active model capabilities.

checks.check: Text truncation, formatting, or omitted metadata plausibly limits the encoder.
checks.how: Inspect tokenized samples and the text/metadata schema.

checks.check: Spatial or spectral preprocessing removes relevant structure or mismatches trained inputs.
checks.how: Inspect transformed examples and saved extraction settings.

checks.check: Several aligned modalities or channels exist and their use or fusion remains unresolved.
checks.how: Inspect available inputs, branch outputs, and existing modality ablations.

checks.check: The number and ordering of records per prediction entity are not yet established.
checks.how: Inspect entity counts, sorted timestamps, feature prefixes, and missingness summaries.

checks.check: No working entity-level feature baseline exists.
checks.how: Inspect the feature table and training inputs for duplicate prediction IDs and missing aggregation logic.

checks.check: Only the last observation or one central statistic is currently retained.
checks.how: Compare the aggregation specification with within-entity variation and existing importance plots.

checks.check: Full-history aggregates obscure behavior near the prediction time.
checks.how: Compare recent and full-history distributions, history lengths, and the label time horizon.

checks.check: Entities have ordered histories whose recent changes are not represented.
checks.how: Inspect sequence lengths, time ordering, and whether current aggregates discard direction of change.

checks.check: Domain-related columns have a meaningful ratio or deviation not present in the features.
checks.how: Inspect column definitions and the existing derived-feature list, then review prior interaction ablations.

checks.check: Timestamps vary meaningfully across entities and have been discarded from the feature table.
checks.how: Compare timestamp ranges and target patterns with the current aggregation outputs.

checks.check: A wide feature table has stable cross-fold importance estimates.
checks.how: Compare rankings across fitted folds and inspect whether low-ranked columns dominate feature count.

checks.check: A particular added feature family coincided with a regression or is error-prone.
checks.how: Review feature-version diffs, prior group ablations, and implementation failures.

checks.check: Some columns are almost entirely missing.
checks.how: Compute column missingness on train and validation and inspect the model’s use of those columns.

checks.check: The classifier consumes a truncated backbone embedding and full-dimensional checkpoints are available.
checks.how: Inspect pooled tensor width, head parameter count, and compatible checkpoint configurations.

checks.check: The current tree implementation handles missing values and added preprocessing erases missingness or removes useful extremes.
checks.how: Inspect estimator capabilities, aggregation-generated NaNs, and prior preprocessing ablations.

checks.check: At least one active model rejects missing values or lacks native handling.
checks.how: Inspect estimator input checks and the finite-value fraction of its actual feature matrix.

checks.check: Low-precision storage creates spurious fine-scale differences relative to meaningful measurement resolution.
checks.how: Compare raw and stored values, unique-value spacing, and dtype conversion code.

checks.check: Relevant text lies outside the retained token range or is diluted by unrelated spans.
checks.how: Inspect token-length distributions, truncation examples, and task-relevant span locations.

checks.check: Custom normalization changes text beyond the tokenizer’s training assumptions.
checks.how: Compare before/after examples and existing cleaning ablations.

checks.check: Distinct text fields are flattened together despite different roles in the target.
checks.how: Inspect input schema, encoding templates, and available checkpoints for separate or paired streams.

checks.check: Structured metadata or surface statistics vary with targets but are absent from the model.
checks.how: Inspect train-only metadata summaries, target associations, and the current input signature.

checks.check: Useful fine detail is lost at the current resize and compatible higher-resolution weights exist.
checks.how: Inspect downsampled examples, checkpoint training sizes, and prior resolution probes.

checks.check: The current temporal or spatial window misses the labeled region or includes irrelevant context.
checks.how: Compare timestamp or crop bounds with label scope, sequence lengths, and current retained content.

checks.check: Time-frequency bins are too coarse for the event durations or frequency structure of interest.
checks.how: Inspect spectrograms, transform parameters, sampling rate, and matched checkpoint settings.

checks.check: Input intensity statistics differ from the training preprocessing or target-domain distribution.
checks.how: Compare per-channel statistics and saved normalization code with inference tensors.

checks.check: Known interference frequencies or an unsuitable passband remain in the signal.
checks.how: Inspect spectra, filter response, sampling rate, and documented signal bandwidth.

checks.check: A few extreme values dominate the raw or spectral dynamic range.
checks.how: Inspect value quantiles and plots before and after current clipping.

checks.check: A natural-image backbone receives scalar spectral images and a color encoding has not been tested.
checks.how: Inspect input channels, pretraining expectations, and any compatible color-encoded checkpoints.

checks.check: An arbitrary signal-to-image factorization creates implausible local neighborhoods.
checks.how: Trace the reshape dimensions and visualize adjacent image positions against original time and channel indices.

checks.check: Useful channels are available in the same signal but excluded from the current tensor.
checks.how: Compare raw channels and derived-channel definitions with model input indices.

checks.check: A different modality or representation carries information the current branch cannot see.
checks.how: Inspect paired samples, existing standalone modality scores, and available compatible training paths.

checks.check: An existing branch adds substantial complexity and its incremental benefit is unverified or negative.
checks.how: Inspect previous branch ablations and branch-specific outputs on the same rows.

checks.check: Equal-width branch embeddings are averaged before classification, potentially discarding distinct information.
checks.how: Inspect fusion code, feature dimensions, and compatible heads for concatenation and averaging.

checks.check: Data quantity, label quality, duplication, or imbalance is the observed limitation.
checks.how: Inspect learning curves, sample provenance, counts, and quality-stratified errors.

checks.check: Censoring or evaluation-group fairness is not represented appropriately by the current target.
checks.how: Inspect outcome schema, target construction, and per-group scores.

checks.check: Training overfits despite plausible label-preserving input perturbations being available.
checks.how: Inspect train/validation gaps and examples of domain-compatible transforms.

checks.check: A substantial labeled holdout remains unused after the configuration has already been selected.
checks.how: Inspect split sizes, stopping strategy, and the independently saved validation evidence.

checks.check: Additional labeled examples exist with compatible targets and adaptable input shapes.
checks.how: Inspect their provenance, label definitions, distribution, and previous inclusion experiments.

checks.check: Unlabeled examples and a pseudo-labeling procedure already improved another comparable member.
checks.how: Review available pseudo-label artifacts, confidence diagnostics, and labeled-only versus pseudo-labeled validation results.

checks.check: Training examples contain duplicated windows, flagged outliers, or measurable label-quality variation.
checks.how: Inspect overlap IDs, out-of-fold residuals, annotator counts, and retained sample counts under proposed filters.

checks.check: Class imbalance or subgroup error patterns suggest the current sample weighting is unsuitable.
checks.how: Compare class counts and per-class held-out errors with the metric’s weighting and earlier weight sweeps.

checks.check: The outcome is censored and ordinary regression targets do not express the observed event information.
checks.how: Inspect event indicators, observation times, censoring rates, and current target-building code.

checks.check: The metric scores predefined groups and their outcome distributions differ substantially.
checks.how: Read the metric grouping definition and compare training-only event and censoring distributions by group.

checks.check: Some groups have too few observed events for stable group-specific transforms.
checks.how: Count events and inspect transform stability across training folds within each group.

checks.check: Image intensity varies naturally but strong augmentation has previously distorted useful structure.
checks.how: Inspect image distributions and augmentation examples alongside prior magnitude sweeps.

checks.check: The model sees spectrograms and should tolerate missing local time-frequency evidence.
checks.how: Inspect signal events and candidate masks to confirm they do not systematically erase the full target interval.

checks.check: Labels are soft distributions and the existing training code already supports weighted example mixing.
checks.how: Inspect label normalization and mixup weights and compare previous mixed versus unmixed training results.

checks.check: The current predictor’s inductive bias or pretraining domain appears unsuitable.
checks.how: Compare standalone errors, data modality, and available alternative predictors.

checks.check: The backbone is useful but pooling or the output head is limiting.
checks.how: Review architecture and head-only ablation results.

checks.check: A tree model’s capacity, regularization, or round budget is implicated by learning curves.
checks.how: Inspect tree fit and validation traces.

checks.check: Neural optimization or objective mismatch is visible in training diagnostics.
checks.how: Inspect optimizer, loss, activation, and rate traces.

checks.check: The available trained states differ more than recent architecture changes or stopping is poorly configured.
checks.how: Review checkpoint scores, training curves, and component-training audits.

checks.check: The current family has plateaued despite useful features and controlled tuning.
checks.how: Review the single-model tuning history and whether an alternative family offers a different treatment of the data.

checks.check: A domain-relevant or structurally different pretrained backbone is available.
checks.how: Inspect its training domain, expected inputs, and existing standalone validation evidence.

checks.check: Capacity appears limiting or a smaller model may meet the same quality target.
checks.how: Compare train/validation errors, resource use, and available size-matched checkpoints.

checks.check: Pretrained embeddings are available but end-to-end fine-tuning is noisy or expensive.
checks.how: Inspect cached representation quality, sample count, and variance across fine-tuning runs.

checks.check: Similar labeled examples exist and a leakage-free retrieval index can be built for each validation fold.
checks.how: Inspect nearest-neighbor examples and verify that the query’s label and validation rows are excluded from its index.

checks.check: The tuned standard tree booster still appears to overfit and a dropout-based variant is supported.
checks.how: Inspect train/validation curves and prior booster comparisons, including whether early stopping works for the variant.

checks.check: The backbone is strong but its current head is only a minimal projection.
checks.how: Inspect architecture definitions and the plateau under backbone-fixed experiments.

checks.check: A complex multi-head or normalization design has regressed or overfit.
checks.how: Compare train/validation behavior and head ablations with matching checkpoints.

checks.check: Useful token or hidden-layer information is discarded by the current pooling.
checks.how: Inspect pooling code, available hidden states, sequence structure, and earlier pooling comparisons.

checks.check: The main regression target has a meaningful discrete or auxiliary structure that can be learned jointly.
checks.how: Inspect target support and previous auxiliary-task validation results; verify sufficient labels for both tasks.

checks.check: Training fit is poor under shallow trees or prior depth changes show a clear capacity effect.
checks.how: Inspect train/validation curves, depth and leaf settings, and completed capacity probes.

checks.check: Training improves while validation stagnates under the current tree capacity.
checks.how: Compare curves and prior penalties or minimum-leaf settings on the same feature set.

checks.check: Every tree sees all rows and columns and the model overfits after feature selection.
checks.how: Inspect bagging and feature-fraction settings and the held-out gap.

checks.check: Lower learning rates reach the round cap or trigger stopping before sustained convergence.
checks.how: Inspect best iteration, learning rate, round budget, and metric progression near stopping.

checks.check: Tree duration was tuned for a standalone model but it now contributes to a multi-model ensemble.
checks.how: Compare standalone and ensemble validation curves across saved iteration checkpoints.

checks.check: Training is unstable or converges too slowly under the current fine-tuning rate.
checks.how: Inspect loss curves, gradient behavior, rate settings, and previous rate trials.

checks.check: Convergence stalls around the current decay schedule’s transitions.
checks.how: Plot learning rate and validation metric over steps and compare with earlier schedules.

checks.check: The current optimizer has reproducible convergence limitations after learning-rate tuning.
checks.how: Inspect optimization traces and prior controlled rate sweeps before comparing another optimizer.

checks.check: The pretrained backbone fits training data well but the added head overfits.
checks.how: Inspect train/validation gaps and the head’s current dropout and capacity.

checks.check: The output activation or training loss imposes assumptions inconsistent with the labels or task metric.
checks.how: Compare mutually exclusive versus independent targets, distributional labels, or pairwise ranking requirements with the current head and loss.

checks.check: The metric is still improving at the training cap or extra epochs have started to overfit.
checks.how: Inspect held-out learning curves and saved adjacent-epoch checkpoints.

checks.check: Stopping occurs during noisy short plateaus, especially with a reduced learning rate.
checks.how: Inspect the patience window, curve fluctuations, and later improvements in longer runs.

checks.check: Several compatible trained states already exist with different validation results.
checks.how: Inspect checkpoint metadata, stage provenance, and fixed-pipeline scores.

checks.check: Several late states of one compatible architecture are available and individual weights remain noisy.
checks.how: Inspect training continuity, parameter keys, and validation behavior of those states.

checks.check: A weak ensemble component lacks the fold discipline or tuning used by the stronger components.
checks.how: Audit its split indices, saved OOF predictions, data loading, and training configuration.

checks.check: The value of specific active or candidate members is uncertain.
checks.how: Inspect addition, replacement, and leave-one-out results.

checks.check: Current members have highly correlated errors and additional independent prediction sources are available.
checks.how: Compare residual correlations with available architectures, representations, folds, and seeds.

checks.check: Membership is stable but existing weights ignore quality differences or group sizes.
checks.how: Inspect effective coefficients, member scores, and previous weighting comparisons.

checks.check: Member output scales or activation order are inconsistent with the intended metric and blend.
checks.how: Inspect score distributions, links, and the aggregation formula.

checks.check: Aligned OOF predictions support a learned combiner and its capacity or features remain unresolved.
checks.how: Inspect OOF provenance and meta-model validation results.

checks.check: A compatible unused candidate has reasonable standalone predictions and potentially different residual errors.
checks.how: Inspect aligned candidate predictions, standalone scores, residual correlations, and earlier inclusion trials.

checks.check: A stronger or different candidate is available for a known weak or redundant slot.
checks.how: Compare the current slot and replacement on the same held-out rows and inspect their correlations with the rest of the blend.

checks.check: An active member has repeatedly worsened the fixed blend or seems redundant.
checks.how: Read leave-one-out results and per-member residual correlations using unchanged weights or renormalized baselines.

checks.check: No same-split comparison establishes that the ensemble beats its strongest member.
checks.how: Inspect saved standalone and ensemble scores on identical examples.

checks.check: The current regression followed removal of members that previously had positive ablation evidence.
checks.how: Compare member manifests before and after the regression and locate their validated prediction files.

checks.check: Most active members share one architecture or algorithm and their residuals are highly correlated.
checks.how: Inspect the member manifest and held-out residual correlation matrix.

checks.check: An available modality, feature set, or preprocessing variant is absent from current members.
checks.how: Compare training representations and standalone validation results for the alternate path.

checks.check: Different valid outcome transforms produce complementary residuals for the same task.
checks.how: Inspect OOF predictions from existing transformed-target models and verify target-direction alignment.

checks.check: Training seeds produce substantial variance while architecture and fold setup remain fixed.
checks.how: Compare saved independent-seed predictions and same-split score distributions.

checks.check: Additional compatible fold checkpoints are unused and prior fold additions have improved validation.
checks.how: Inspect fold coverage, checkpoint provenance, and the marginal-gain table.

checks.check: One or more fold checkpoints are incompatible or repeatedly harm the full average on reliable validation.
checks.how: Check checkpoint metadata and fixed-pipeline full-versus-subset scores across held-out samples.

checks.check: Members have comparable quality and tuned weights have not reliably improved the simple average.
checks.how: Compare uniform and tuned blend scores across the same held-out samples or repeated evaluations.

checks.check: Component quality differs reproducibly or a member’s predictions have changed since weights were tuned.
checks.how: Inspect standalone scores, OOF residuals, and artifact versions relative to the saved weight configuration.

checks.check: A candidate’s residual contribution appears negatively correlated with the remaining blend’s error.
checks.how: Compute conditional residual associations and inspect prior small signed-weight probes on held-out data.

checks.check: Model families contain unequal numbers of folds or variants.
checks.how: Count members per group and expand the current formula into effective per-family weights.

checks.check: Current weights depend on statistics of a very small or varying inference sample.
checks.how: Inspect weight-generation code and the sample count and variability used to estimate adaptive coefficients.

checks.check: Different components consistently win on different classes with adequate validation examples.
checks.how: Compare per-class held-out errors and sample counts across folds.

checks.check: Useful score magnitudes or calibrated additive corrections are already validated.
checks.how: Inspect raw-versus-rank comparisons and whether downstream adjustments rely on absolute scale.

checks.check: The metric is rank-based and member score distributions differ in calibration or scale.
checks.how: Read the metric definition and plot per-member prediction distributions and held-out raw/rank blend results.

checks.check: Stacking or weighted blending mixes columns with different scales or outlier-heavy outputs.
checks.how: Inspect OOF column quantiles and scaler fitting code; compare spread and outliers across members.

checks.check: Overconfident member probabilities cluster near the boundaries and their magnitude dominates the blend.
checks.how: Inspect probability histograms and existing held-out power-transform comparisons.

checks.check: Compatible pre-softmax logits are available and the task scores categorical probability distributions.
checks.how: Inspect saved logits, class ordering, and the distributional metric before comparing combination order.

checks.check: Current inputs to an arithmetic average are unnormalized outputs although the blend is intended to average distributions.
checks.how: Inspect each member’s output activation and row sums before averaging.

checks.check: A fixed blend has plateaued and enough aligned held-out base predictions exist to fit a small combiner.
checks.how: Inspect OOF coverage, row alignment, sample count relative to member count, and fixed-blend scores.

checks.check: The current stacker’s model class underfits or a complex stacker overfits the available meta-data.
checks.how: Compare training and held-out meta-model errors and prior family ablations.

checks.check: The current meta-learner’s best setting lies at a search boundary or coefficients are unstable.
checks.how: Inspect search history, convergence warnings, and coefficient variation across folds.

checks.check: Useful new OOF outputs or embeddings exist, or the current meta-feature schema contains weak redundant columns.
checks.how: Inspect feature provenance, alignment, correlations, and previous meta-feature ablations.

checks.check: Validated symmetries or unintended stochastic inference could explain residual variance.
checks.how: Inspect transforms, evaluation mode, and repeated prediction files.

checks.check: Prediction bias, scale, or probability mass conflicts with the output requirements or validation labels.
checks.how: Inspect residuals, calibration plots, ranges, and row sums.

checks.check: Discrete target support or degenerate ties affect the ranking metric.
checks.how: Inspect target levels and raw/post-processed prediction uniqueness.

checks.check: Auxiliary predictions or reliable metadata support a targeted correction.
checks.how: Inspect held-out conditional errors and correction ablations.

checks.check: The task has label-preserving transformations represented by the trained model.
checks.how: Inspect domain symmetries, training augmentations, and prior transformed-view validation results.

checks.check: A small noisy task may benefit from stochastic head averaging and dropout can be activated deliberately.
checks.how: Inspect model mode and verify that repeated dropout-enabled passes actually vary while other layers remain appropriate for inference.

checks.check: Repeated inference changes scores unexpectedly or dropout settings are being tuned while inactive.
checks.how: Compare identical-run predictions and inspect evaluation mode, random transforms, seeds, and dynamic batching.

checks.check: Held-out regression residuals show a stable offset or a reliable reference example exposes one.
checks.how: Inspect signed residual means across folds and reference-example prediction error.

checks.check: A component’s bounded activation compresses its contribution to a heterogeneous blend.
checks.how: Inspect pre-activation distributions and held-out blended performance across existing temperature settings.

checks.check: Class probability mass is systematically biased on a representative validation set.
checks.how: Compare predicted and observed class distributions and per-class calibration diagnostics.

checks.check: The task requires bounded values or row-normalized probabilities and current outputs violate that contract.
checks.how: Read the output requirements and compute ranges and row sums after every activation.

checks.check: Only ordering is scored and added scaling or clipping has no validated benefit.
checks.how: Inspect the metric’s invariances and compare rank order before and after current transforms, including ties.

checks.check: Targets occupy a small set of repeated levels while model outputs are fully continuous.
checks.how: Inspect unique target values and their frequencies by output column and the metric’s treatment of tied ranks.

checks.check: Existing binning collapses one or more prediction columns to a constant.
checks.how: Count distinct values and variance per column after binning and compare with the raw outputs.

checks.check: Exact prediction ties are common and their treatment can change the scored ordering.
checks.how: Inspect tied-value counts and the metric implementation, then check existing tie-preserving and tie-breaking comparisons.

checks.check: An auxiliary classifier or head gives held-out information not captured by the main prediction.
checks.how: Inspect its confidence, error correlation, and previously tested correction magnitudes on aligned rows.

checks.check: A prediction-time metadata condition almost determines a particular target in training and held-out examples.
checks.how: Cross-tabulate the condition and target by split and inspect exceptions and distribution shift.

checks.check: The current post-processing was tuned for older checkpoints or its contribution is unverified.
checks.how: Compare artifact versions and fixed-model correction-on versus correction-off results.
